goal: Bind fixed command readings and graph-audit probe receipts to completed local Workflow transcripts
asset: Native Workflow journals, per-agent transcripts and source-backed execution evidence
scope: Bounded source selection from a configured Claude projects store
Exact ordered Bash tool ids, fixed output normalization and worktree metadata
Artifact digest readback and graph-audit probe postprocessing
outOfScope: A cryptographic trust boundary against writers with access to all local runtime files
Claiming a live native Workflow observation when the current executor exposes no Workflow tool
Binding arbitrary tools or silently accepting unknown transcript shapes

record.question: Which evidence can corroborate a worker transcription without trusting the transcription itself?

options.strongest_objection: Native source formats are internal and may require future adapters
Long output may be condensed or commands retyped

record.rationale: Read the runtime journal, agent transcript and meta together, then compare exact tool commands, cwd and output under fixed documented normalization.
evidence: Issue197 supplies native duplicate tool-event and raw-result shapes
Existing replay_memo locates completed native Workflow source captures

costs.cost: One bounded read of each selected runtime source plus artifact readback
evidence: Runtime JSONL already stores tool use ids and raw results

costs.cost: False certification of condensed or fabricated output

requirements.statement: A binding requires one completed native source agent, exact ordered Bash calls, matching worktree cwd, one StructuredOutput, and equal readings after only fixed normalization; conflicting duplicates and unlisted tools refuse.
requirements.counterexample: A transport copy erases cwd or a worker condenses output and binding still passes

requirements.statement: Long output artifacts are read back against digests echoed in native output; graph-audit command receipts stay pending until a source binding verifies each probe.
requirements.counterexample: A model-provided audit receipt or arbitrary artifact path alone establishes bound command evidence

checks.scope: Actual on-disk native-shaped journal/meta/transcript fixtures and CLI postprocessing
assumptions: Local capture files are runtime-owned in the normal host workflow but are not signed by the service
Native Workflow execution is unavailable in this executor; fixture evidence does not establish a live runtime observation

challenges.claim: Can a model return a certificate that the Workflow itself cannot read from disk?
challenges.resolution: No. The primitive reads native sources after completion; graph-audit surfaces pending binding and its command runs the postprocessor before accepting SOUND.
